name: Obsidra
tagline: The operating system for industrial hygiene at planetary scale.
positioning: Obsidra unifies sanitation across every facility, shift, and surface — turning industrial cleaning from a cost center into measurable, auditable infrastructure.

hero.h1: Command every clean across your entire industrial footprint.
hero.sub: Obsidra turns sanitation crews, chemistry, and compliance into one live system — so plant managers stop reconstructing what happened and start proving it happened.

features.title: Surface-level telemetry
features.description: Track every zone, from clean-in-place lines to loading docks, with sensor-verified completion instead of clipboard signatures nobody can audit.

features.title: Chemistry orchestration
features.description: Dose, dilute, and log sanitizer usage automatically. Obsidra reconciles chemical draw against square footage cleaned, flagging waste before finance does.

features.title: Audit-ready in one click
features.description: Generate FDA, USDA, and internal HACCP records from live data. Your next inspection becomes a filter, not a fire drill.

features.title: Shift intelligence
features.description: See which crews, sites, and hours run clean and which drift. Obsidra learns your baselines and escalates anomalies to the right supervisor.

features.title: Multi-site command
features.description: One control plane for 3 plants or 300. Standardize SOPs globally, adapt them locally, and roll changes out without another all-hands memo.

features.title: Predictive re-clean
features.description: Model contamination risk from traffic, temperature, and cycle history so you re-sanitize before a swab test — not after a recall.

testimonials.quote: We used to reconstruct our sanitation record from three binders and a group text. With Obsidra, our overnight validation shrank from six hours to forty minutes — and it survived a surprise audit untouched.
testimonials.name: Dana Escobar

testimonials.quote: The chemistry reconciliation alone paid for the platform. We were over-dosing sanitizer across nine facilities and had no idea until Obsidra put it on one screen.
testimonials.name: Rui Takahashi

testimonials.quote: Obsidra made our cleaning program legible to the board for the first time. Sanitation stopped being a mystery line item and became a metric we manage.
testimonials.name: Priya Vandermeer

homepage.footerBlurb: Obsidra is the industrial hygiene platform for enterprises that treat clean as infrastructure. Measurable. Auditable. Absolute.
